div.span: A request without a usable token gets 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://<distribution>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp" from the CloudFront Function, after the web ACL. The origin serves that RFC 9728 document (cached by CloudFront); on pattern 1 the function answers it.

div.span: The function decodes the JWT and refuses a missing, malformed, expired, wrong-issuer or non-access token at the edge. It does not check the signature (CloudFront Functions have no RSA verify), so it replaces any client-sent x-jwt-claims with the decoded payload for the regional WAF.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 38px; height: 1px; padding-top: 304px; margin-left: 1325px;

div.span: The client follows the metadata to the issuer and requests a client-credentials token with the pattern’s scope. Scopes stand in for an audience: a token for one pattern is refused by the others.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 38px; height: 1px; padding-top: 396px; margin-left: 1325px;

display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 526px; height: 1px; padding-top: 378px; margin-left: 1378px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.span: Each origin checks the RS256 signature against the Cognito JWKS and requires its own scope: the AgentCore Gateway authorizer, the API Gateway Cognito authorizer, or the hello server itself (web function, ALB). A tampered payload passes the edge and fails here.
